# ToddTalk (toddzheng.net)

> Personal site of Todd Zheng (郑秋石): essays and notes on AI agents, developer tools, software engineering, and internet history. Bilingual English and Chinese.

Canonical site: https://toddzheng.net/
Author: Todd Zheng / 郑秋石

## Primary

- [English homepage](https://toddzheng.net/en/): English entry. Chinese homepage: https://toddzheng.net/zh/
- [About (EN)](https://toddzheng.net/en/about/): Profile and background. Chinese: https://toddzheng.net/zh/about/
- [Projects (EN)](https://toddzheng.net/en/projects/): Products and open-source work. Chinese: https://toddzheng.net/zh/projects/
- [Blog index (EN)](https://toddzheng.net/en/blog/): All English posts. Chinese: https://toddzheng.net/zh/blog/
- [Series index (EN)](https://toddzheng.net/en/series/): Published series. Chinese: https://toddzheng.net/zh/series/

## Featured writing

- [Skill + CLI Considered Harmful — MCP vs Skills vs CLI](https://toddzheng.net/en/blog/skill-cli-considered-harmful/): Why Skill+CLI agent integrations reintroduce fat-client version drift; MCP comparison. Chinese: https://toddzheng.net/zh/blog/skill-cli-considered-harmful/
- [The Electricity of Our Era](https://toddzheng.net/en/blog/electricity-of-our-era/): Token economics and provider-agnostic agent harnesses. Chinese: https://toddzheng.net/zh/blog/electricity-of-our-era/
- [Software 3.0 Workshop — Agent Automation Economics](https://toddzheng.net/en/blog/software-3-0-workshop-2026-08-29/): How Software 3.0 changes when niche automation is worth building. Chinese: https://toddzheng.net/zh/blog/software-3-0-workshop-2026-08-29/
- [The Dotcom Chronicles (series)](https://toddzheng.net/en/series/dotcom-chronicles/): From the birth of the Web through early web history. Chinese series: https://toddzheng.net/zh/series/dotcom-chronicles/
